foragers-shelf.text: The first room of the village hall, open from the start. Bring in what the woods and hedges give each season.

larder.text: The hall's pantry. It asks for crops by season, crops of good quality, animal goods and artisan goods.

water-room.text: For anglers. Fill it and the ferry is mended, and the lake cove opens.

hearth.text: The workshop room of the hall. Its bundles are the smith's, the weaver's and the lamplighter's.

guests-board.text: Where the village leaves its requests: the dyer, the cook, fodder for the animals, the host and the storyteller. Finishing it deepens every friendship.

last-seat.text: The last and hardest room. It opens once every other bundle is done.
